name: Harley-Davidson Road Glide
engine: Milwaukee-Eight 107 or 114 V-twin, oil-cooled heads, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: A Milwaukee-Eight touring Harley. Check for oil sumping on early bikes and the clutch actuator recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2017-2018 touring bikes are in recall 18V734 because the hydraulic clutch actuator can leak inside and stop the clutch from releasing.
A-002.reason: A clutch that won't release can cause a crash. The repair is free.

add.title: Check for oil sumping
add.instructions: On 2017-2019 bikes, look for oil in the air cleaner and on the right side of the engine after a long ride. Ask whether the oil pump was updated to the 2020 part.
add.reason: Sumping wastes oil and can coat the air filter.
add.src: Harley-Davidson 2020 service bulletin on M8 sumping

recalls.what: Clutch actuator can leak inside, and the clutch may not disengage.

known.title: Oil sumping (2017-2019)
known.what: Early Milwaukee-Eight engines can build up oil in the crankcase and push it out the air cleaner. The fix is the 2020-style oil pump.
